name: Aristograd
ability: Cryptobiosis (its own: once per battle, a hit that would knock it out leaves it at 1 HP) / Water Veil / Shell Armor (hidden)
look: a great round white-and-lavender water bear with a pink mouth ring, eight stubby clawed legs and four pods in its back with Tardigrubs peeking out
entry: It carries its young in four pods in its back. In battle it fires them at its foes two at a time; the little ones bounce off, scurry back and climb in again, thrilled.
how: Evolve Tardigrub at level 35. It learns Grub Volley when it evolves.
Wild: rare in swamps and rivers.
